name: – Karin Karlsbro – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the proposal for a Council decision on the termination of the Voluntary Partnership Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of Liberia on Forest Law Enforcement Governance and Trade in timber products to the European Union
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion on a plan to end the EU's timber trade agreement with Liberia, signed in 2013. Liberia never set up the system to prove its timber is legal, so the deal never fully worked. Parliament regrets ending it and asks the European Commission to agree a new "forest partnership" with Liberia first, so cooperation on forests, community rights and legal logging does not simply stop.

- **What changes:** The binding timber agreement with Liberia is set to end; Parliament wants a new partnership agreed first.
- **Who it affects:** Liberia's forests, logging businesses, local and indigenous communities, and EU timber importers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must present a transition plan and negotiate the new partnership within one year.
